connectivity.producer: The exact-window observation sampler detects the local combat generation and schedules one asynchronous automatic-combat maintenance intent without waiting for physical input.
connectivity.transport: XinshouRunnerAutoCombatState fences window, taskRunId and combat generation, while InputActionQueue retains the existing exact binding and pause/stop tokens for the global InputActionWorker.
connectivity.consumer: The existing XinshouCombatLocalMechanics executes through the serialized physical-input owner and asynchronously records completion or bounded retry without blocking observation.
connectivity.ordering: local combat edge -> exact generation claim -> one asynchronous maintenance -> global input serialization -> exact-session completion or retry; a replaced run ignores every late completion.

proves: One combat generation has at most one in-flight maintenance operation.
A completion from a replaced task run cannot update the current session.
An indefinitely blocked maintenance port does not block the observation caller.
The same in-flight generation is never submitted twice.

connectivity.producer: The local dialog matcher retains the existing option set and exact click coordinate, then enqueues one atomic move/click instead of waiting in the observation thread.
connectivity.transport: Input completion publishes the existing stable TIANTING_DIALOG_CLICKED key event into the Runner retained mailbox; observation HTTPS uses a separate one-in-flight transport thread and exact ACK lifecycle.
connectivity.consumer: Cloud consumes the same stable action key and existing executed result; no dialog option, fallback order, coordinate, template or phase meaning changes.
connectivity.ordering: local match and revalidation -> asynchronous atomic input -> retained completion event -> next available observation request -> exact Cloud ACK; meanwhile local combat/pathing sampling continues.

proves: Only the observation transport thread waits for Cloud HTTP.
The resident observation thread keeps sampling while one request is in flight.
All existing Tianting dialog options retain their action keys, one-shot behavior and follow-up semantics through asynchronous completion.
Failed physical input still reports the stable action with executed=false.
